title: eudesmis
intro: Eudesmis, commonly known as Eudesmia or Eudesma, is a genus of flowering plants in the family Asteraceae. This plant is known to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing pain and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Eudesmis include its potential to act as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant agent. The bioactive constituents of Eudesmis include sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, and other compounds such as flavonoids and phenolic acids.
